Name: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Vulnerability
Synopsis: The remote web server is vulnerable to HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Denial of Service.
Description: An attacker can exploit HTTP/2 stream reset frames to cause resource exhaustion.
Solution: Upgrade web server daemon to current patched release or disable HTTP/2 stream processing.
Plugin Output: HTTP/2 enabled on port 443 with rapid stream reset support detected.

Name: PostgreSQL Buffer Overflow via Malformed Query
Synopsis: The remote PostgreSQL database engine allows remote memory corruption.
Description: Unauthenticated remote code execution via buffer boundary failure.
Solution: Apply PostgreSQL maintenance update 15.4 or higher.

Name: Microsoft Outlook / SMB NTLM Credential Reflection (MonikerLink)
Synopsis: Remote attackers can bypass Protected View and leak NTLM hashes.
Description: Sending a specially crafted file: link triggers NTLM credential relay.
Solution: Apply Microsoft security bulletin patch KB5034763.
Plugin Output: Unpatched SMB client configuration detected on port 445.

Name: Apache Log4j2 JNDI Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
Synopsis: The remote Java application is vulnerable to unauthenticated remote code execution.
Description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI message lookup parsing allows external code loading.
Solution: Upgrade Log4j to version 2.17.1 or remove JndiLookup.class from classpath.
Plugin Output: Vulnerable Log4j core jar 2.14.1 found in application archive.

Name: Spring Framework Class Loader Access (Spring4Shell)
Synopsis: Spring Framework RCE via Data Binding parameter manipulation.
Description: A Spring MVC or WebFlux application on JDK 9+ allows class loader binding.

Name: OpenSSL BN_mod_sqrt Infinite Loop Denial of Service
Synopsis: Parsing malformed certificates triggers an infinite loop.
Description: Adversaries can trigger remote denial of service via invalid elliptic curve params.
Solution: Upgrade OpenSSL package to version 1.1.1n or 3.0.2.
